definitions: To achieve success or advantage by associating oneself with a more successful or influential person or group.
To benefit from the efforts or achievements of another without contributing significantly oneself.
examples: He tried to ride coattails to get ahead in the company.
She was accused of riding coattails on her partner's project.
They hoped to ride coattails of the popular movement.
pastTenses: rode coattails (past simple), ridden coattails (past perfect)
